job: Sort GitHub stars into one category each from a fixed list
data_size: 5,199 repo names, descriptions and topics, plus 8 retries; ~670 tokens per request including the category list
notes: Rated from about 40 labels read by eye. 8 rows invented a category outside the list (no schema enforcement on this route); 7 fixed on retry. 4.5 minutes at 16 workers. Sync was cheaper than batch for this input-heavy job.
